meta.title: [alpha_factory] switch to Observable Plot for frontier rendering
meta.body_summary: Switch D3 frontier rendering to Observable Plot for alpha_factory demo, adding credibilityColor helper, dependencies, and a Playwright performance test.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex replaced D3 frontend rendering with Observable Plot, adding a Playwright perf test; merged instantly without review or benchmark data.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 218 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume, appropriate for a low-touch library swap in a demo frontend. The instant self-merge is consistent with the low-risk, self-contained nature of the change.

review_details.performance_claim: Observable Plot provides better frontier rendering performance than D3.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple frontend library swap with dependency updates and a new Playwright test; within agent capability for small, self-contained UI changes in a demo project.

core_change_summary.description: Switched frontier rendering from D3 to Observable Plot in dist/app.js and src/render/frontier.js; added credibilityColor helper in colors.js; added Playwright performance test in tests/test_plot_perf.py; updated index.html and package.json with Observable Plot dependencies.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: HTML and package.json updated for Observable Plot integration; colors.js added helper for credibility coloring.
